task: Audit Instructor, Faculty, and Student Pages to Ensure Workflow Synchronization with No Overlaps and Errors

root_cause_analysis.issue: Multi-role navigation, page routing, and capstone progression suffered from phase labeling divergence, unguarded instructor/student routes in App.jsx, hardcoded role prop leaks in ProjectDetailPage, and desynchronized Header back navigation leading students to instructor cohort pages.
culprits: ProjectsPage.jsx had corrupted phase collapse tabs that conflated Phase 1 and 2, omitted Phase 4 (Final Defense), and lacked student auto-redirection.
MyProjectPage.jsx threw runtime ReferenceError due to unimported ROLES constant from @cms/shared, failing non-student redirection to /projects.
ProjectDetailPage.jsx had hardcoded role props (isStudent={false} and isFaculty={true}) on WorkflowPhaseTracker and Capstone1CollapsibleSections, bypassing dynamic auth role derivation.
Header.jsx lacked role awareness in getBackDestination(), sending students viewing project detail pages back to instructor cohort directory (/projects) instead of student capstone portal (/project).

App.jsx lacked explicit role protection (allowedRoles) across administrative (/users, /admin/audit, /reports, /archive/upload/*), student proposal/submission (/project/create, /project/approval, /project/submissions/upload, /project/proposal), and committee evaluation (/submissions/:id/review, /adviser/team-review) routes.
Secretary review routes erroneously listed ROLES.INSTRUCTOR in allowedRoles despite institutional rules strictly barring course instructors from capstone defense committees.

modifications.summary: Restored canonical 4-Phase Capstone Progression (Phase 1: Title Defense, Phase 2: Manuscripts, Phase 3: System Dev, Phase 4: Final Defense), aligned KPI metrics/query filters, and added auto-redirect for students landing on /projects to /project.
Imported ROLES from @cms/shared to resolve ReferenceError and implemented reliable redirection of instructors and faculty from /project to /projects.
Replaced hardcoded isStudent={false} and isFaculty={true} props on WorkflowPhaseTracker and Capstone1CollapsibleSections with dynamic auth-derived roles (isStudent and isFaculty).

Updated getBackDestination(pathname, role) to make back-navigation role-aware, routing students on project subpages back to /project ('Back to My Capstone') instead of instructor directory (/projects).
Normalized team group formation institutional policy copy from '(1-4 members)' to '(2-4 members)' per BukSU Capstone Phase 0 rules.

Hardened PROTECTED_ROUTES with explicit allowedRoles: instructor-only on /users, /admin/audit, /reports, /archive/upload/*; student-only on /project/create, /project/approval, chapter upload, proposal compilation; faculty/committee only on /secretary-review and /adviser/team-review; committee/instructor on submission reviews.
Expanded role-protection test suite to verify 403 Forbidden gating for students on /users, /reports, /admin/audit, /submissions/:id/review and instructors on committee secretary review.
Added unit test asserting non-student auto-redirect from /project to /projects.

governance_battery.validate_governance: Prefetch 11 agents, Sync DAG valid, Decision Coherence 0 errors / 0 warnings

lessons_learned: Lesson: When adding role-based redirection guards in React components, ensure imported role constants (ROLES) exist in the module import statement; omitting them causes silent runtime ReferenceErrors that halt component execution in production while potentially being bypassed in tests with partial mocks.

Lesson: Route-level protection (RoleRoute) should only be applied to strictly segregated paths. Mutually reciprocal paths (/project vs /projects) should use component-level redirection so neither students nor faculty encounter harsh 403 Forbidden screens when navigating between single and plural route variants.

Lesson: Course Instructors must be systematically excluded from committee evaluation routes (/secretary-review, /adviser/team-review) across both client navigation (Sidebar, App.jsx) and backend RBAC authorization middleware to maintain institutional compliance.
